target_customer: AI product teams running production inference at scale who want the right model at the best price
problem: Most teams pay for a top model by default. RouterPlus finds the right model for a team's workload from its own evals and traffic, then gets it served at scale at the best price.
business_model: Inference marketplace and routing layer, providers compete for the customer's workload, fee schedule not published

founders.name: Alok Bishoyi
founders.background_notes: YC page: Managing Director at AWL Inc scaling edge AI deployments to 10,000+ sites; early-stage investor at Day Zero Ventures.

founders.name: Lakshmi Narayana
education: IIT Bombay, BS in Computer Science
founders.background_notes: YC page: first hire and CTO at Trupeer AI, four years at Samsung in South Korea building GPU infrastructure for ML.

competitors.name: OpenRouter
competitors.what: Unified API marketplace to 400+ models and 70+ providers
competitors.funding_then: 113M round in May 2026 at about 1.3B post-money, after a 40M Series A in 2025

competitors.name: Portkey, LiteLLM, Helicone
competitors.what: Gateways and open-source routing for multiple LLM providers

competitors.name: IonRouter (YC W26)
competitors.what: High-throughput low-cost inference from a YC batch earlier in 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: Routing, eval-based selection and capacity planning across providers is substantial engineering but built from existing model APIs. Company claims 3 million agent conversations a day for its largest customer.

defensibility.rationale: Routing layers are copyable and well funded rivals exist. Customer eval data and reserved capacity relationships could add some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A well funded OpenRouter was already running the same wedge before the batch; no later outcome yet.

market_need_then: Roundups in 2026 list many OpenRouter alternatives and describe provider-agnostic failover and latency-aware routing becoming default expectations, showing real demand for model selection and price control.

identity.logo: Not described in sources opened; page leads with logos of model providers
identity.visual_style: Provider logo strip, playground and demo calls to action
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, short and punchy, slogan: Set the bar. We hold it.

branding.brand_signature: Set the bar. We hold it.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is descriptive and confusable with OpenRouter and generic router products, a branding search returned only networking router hardware. A launch blog by Fondo exists but no community signal found.

outcome_analysis: RouterPlus is a Fall 2026 YC company with no public outcome yet. It claims a large customer at 3 million conversations a day and 25 percent lower P95 latency after switching models, but these are company figures. It competes with OpenRouter, which raised 113M in May 2026, so differentiation through workload-specific evals and provider competition is the open question.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom shows a 125k seed round with no investors, and its page appears to mix RouterPlus with a company called EVO HQ and lists Mumbai while YC lists Bengaluru. Customer results are company claims. No outcome news found.
